meta.name: English
meta.description: Learn how to pray in Islam – a free, step-by-step guide for kids

steps.explanation: We start by praising Allah. Stand up straight and raise your hands.

steps.translation: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds
steps.explanation: Now we thank Allah. We recite Al-Fatiha, the opening chapter of the Quran.
Now we bow down. Bend forward and put your hands on your knees.

steps.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent
steps.explanation: While bowing, we say this three times to praise Allah.
Now we prostrate. Put your forehead, nose, hands, knees, and toes on the floor.

steps.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High
steps.explanation: While prostrating, we say this three times. Allah loves when we are humble.

steps.translation: Peace and mercy of Allah be upon you
steps.explanation: We finish by turning our head right and left, saying peace to the angels.
